content.text: UPF itself reports no crash alarms, but its GTP-U throughput periodically drops to zero (t=8-9,12-13,16-17,20-21,24-25,28-29) exactly matching gNB GTPU_PATH_FAILURE and SMF PFCP_SESSION_ESTABLISHMENT_FAILURE alarms. The router shows stable interface_error_rate (0.0005) throughout with no flap alarms, ruling out transport_flap. UPF logs show continuous heartbeats with no crash/restart events, but user-plane throughput repeatedly collapses to 0 — an internal UPF fault (packet forwarding failure/deadlock) affecting both N3 and N4 paths, recovering periodically. This pattern points to UPF as the root cause (an intermittent internal failure, consistent with crashloop-like symptom of NF instability), rather than transport or SMF/gNB.
